component.name: Lean Studio
component.summary: A desktop IDE for the Lean 4 theorem prover

description.p: Lean Studio is a native desktop IDE built only for Lean 4. It shows the tactic state with Lean's own diff of each step, lists every tactic in a proof with what it changed, and re-checks each declaration you build with Tenet, an independent implementation of Lean's kernel.

It includes a tutorial for newcomers, Prove It (a portfolio of tactics tried on each sorry), a search of Mathlib in plain English, Git and GitHub, and an MCP server so AI assistants can use Lean while they work. Lean itself is installed through elan, which Lean Studio offers to set up.
